public_rationale: No decisive delivery or permanent termination was found for the March Meta agreement. Nebius's August update still described a future deployment. The forecast has no deadline, and the likely three-to-four-year estimate does not turn October 2026 into one. The financing description is imprecise: $3.75 billion was proposed, and the closing release reported $4.3375 billion. That correction does not settle the delivery forecast or establish financing causation.
limitations: Earlier Meta capacity must not be substituted for the new contract.
Partial delivery would refute the categorical reading but would not establish full contract performance.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The data center capacity Nebius contracted to Meta, which let it raise $3.75 billion in debt, does not exist, will likely take three to four years to build, and will never happen.
conditions: likely, for the three-to-four-year build estimate

statement.excerpt: All Nebius had to do to raise $3.75 billion in debt was to sign a deal with Meta for data center capacity that doesn’t exist and will likely take three to four years to build (it’s never happening).
statement.document_title: The AI Industry Is Lying To You

from_speaker: will likely take three to four years to build
our_interpretation: The financing link in the post points to Nebius's own March 17 offering announcement, so its financial basis is company_reported.
The referenced capacity is the new March 2026 Meta agreement, not the earlier Meta agreement.
The principal forecast is that the referenced capacity will never materialize. The likely three-to-four-year estimate is not a firm delivery deadline and conflicts with the absolute parenthetical.
Actual delivery of a meaningful contracted tranche would refute the categorical never-happening reading, but would not prove complete fulfillment.
The assertion that signing the Meta deal was all that financing required is a separate causal assertion; announcement sequence alone cannot establish it.
criteria.support_condition: Definitive termination of the referenced capacity arrangement, with no delivery and no successor arrangement fulfilling it, establishes that it will not materialize. Financing documents must separately substantiate the amount and claimed causal mechanism.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Verified commissioning and delivery to Meta of meaningful capacity under the March 2026 agreement contradicts the categorical non-delivery forecast. A delivery promise, financing close or delivery under an earlier agreement does not.

evidence.explanation: The announcement identifies a future deployment under the new agreement. Its promised delivery date is neither actual delivery nor a deadline supplied by Zitron.
The cited $3.75 billion was the original proposed offering size, subsequently increased. This corrects the financing description without resolving whether the capacity will be delivered.
The closing release reports total original principal of $4.3375 billion after the additional purchase. It establishes financing, but does not show that the Meta signature was its sole requirement.
